text: DSH Structured Output 为 DSH Web Agent 提供结构化 JSON 输出。用户用 `/json-schema` 设置对象 schema，后续回答通过 `StructuredOutput` 工具提交并按 DSH schema 子集校验。可在设置面板按 Agent 预设开启，默认关闭。适合需要可校验 JSON 结果的场景，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Structured Output adds schema-based JSON output for DSH web agents. Set an object schema with `/json-schema`; the next answer goes through `StructuredOutput` and is validated with DSH’s schema subset. Enable it per preset in Settings; it is off by default and needs no API key.
让 DSH 的回答严格按我给的 JSON Schema 输出。
我想让不同 Agent 模式分别决定是否能调用结构化输出工具。
怎么让模型把最终答案作为符合 schema 的 JSON 对象返回？
给 DSH 加一个可以校验 JSON 输出格式的工具。
I need my DSH agent to return JSON that conforms to a schema I provide.
Can I enable structured output for selected agent presets only?
DSH Structured Output 的功能「按 Schema 生成 JSON」：用 `/json-schema <json>` 为会话保存对象 schema，后续提示要求模型通过 `StructuredOutput` 提交答案。
DSH Structured Output 的功能「校验结构化结果」：模型调用 `StructuredOutput` 提交对象时，插件按当前会话保存的 DSH JSON Schema 校验；无活动 schema 或校验失败时拒绝结果。
DSH Structured Output 的功能「按预设控制入口」：在 Web 设置面板为各 Agent 预设切换能力；只在已启用的预设新建 Agent 时注册命令和工具，默认均关闭。

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-structured-output README · Install：`lib/` is generated locally and is not committed. `install.py` always builds
the repository's own toolchain first (`npm install` when the toolchain is
missing, then `npm run build`) and only reports an error when npm itself is
missing.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-structured-output README · Install：Install/uninstall idempotently with the bundled script (stdlib-only
Python). The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml` (id
`structured-output`) and declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the script only links
the package into the profile `node_modules`, adds the `link:` dependency, and
appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` is never modified:

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-structured-output README · Install：```sh
python3 install.py install --profile web          # install
python3 install.py uninstall --profile web        # remove
python3 install.py install --profile web --home "$DSH_HOME"   # explicit home
```

Manual alternative:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-structured-output
```

`dsh plugin` reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` from the installed package's
`dsh.bundle` declaration, so no profile patch edit is needed either.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-structured-output README · Usage：Supported schemas follow dsh's enforced JSON Schema subset with an object
JSON root: object `properties`/`required`/boolean `additionalProperties`, array
`items`, scalar `enum`/`const`, and exact-one `oneOf`. Unsupported keywords
are rejected at `/json-schema` time.
